title: LiteSpeed Cache Review
description: A documented profile of LiteSpeed Cache for WordPress sites running LiteSpeed server caching or QUIC.cloud.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped LiteSpeed Cache WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The plugin bridges WordPress cache rules to LiteSpeed’s cache engine
Its caching features require LiteSpeed server caching or QUIC.cloud
Optimization features remain available without a LiteSpeed server
bestFor: Sites hosted on LiteSpeed or intentionally using QUIC.cloud.
researchScope: This profile reviews LiteSpeed’s own installation and requirements documentation. It does not benchmark hosting configurations.
caveats: Do not use alongside another full-page cache plugin. Without LiteSpeed or QUIC.cloud, the plugin’s caching functionality is unavailable.
